faq.label: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers or search specific questions.

q1.question: How do I connect Kickot chatbot to my Kick channel?
q1.answer: Simply click on "Log in via Kick", authorize your account, and activate Kickot bot in your Dashboard. The bot will join your chat automatically.

q2.question: Is KickALL free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! The basic Kickot chatbot with commands and moderation is completely free forever. Pro and Elite plans are available for advanced tools and unlimited customization.

q3.question: How do I add alerts and widgets to OBS or Streamlabs?
q3.answer: In your Dashboard, generate a unique Browser Source URL and paste it as a new Browser source in OBS / Streamlabs. Settings changes apply live without restarting.

q4.question: Are my data and Kick account safe?
q4.answer: Absolutely. We use official Kick OAuth 2.0 authentication with S256 PKCE encryption standard. We never have access to your passwords or private keys.

q5.question: Can I create custom commands and alerts?
q5.answer: Yes! Through the Dashboard you can create up to 50 commands on the free plan, while on others you can create unlimited. Just visit the commands panel within the Dashboard!
